words.word: how much more then the hearts

occurrences.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
words: how much more then the hearts

occurrences.text: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord God, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
